bundle.text:
# dsh-agent-teams bundle patch: mounts the agent-teams plugin into the host
# composition of a dsh profile. The plugin registers its `agent_teams_*` tools
# into the shared `tools` registry and one usage section into the global
# system prompt, so every session of the profile can drive AgentTeams through
# natural language ("用 AgentTeams 做 X").
#
# Install: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <this package>` (npm or a local
# path). The `dsh plugin` command pnpm-installs the package into the profile
# and reconciles it into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer list.
- insert:
    - id: agent-teams
      # Node-resolvable package name — must stay in sync with package.json
      # `name`. Quoted because `@` is a reserved indicator in YAML and cannot
      # open a plain scalar.
      name: '@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish'
      config:
        # Team state lives under `<session workspace>/<stateDir>/<teamId>/`
        # (team.json + inbox/*.jsonl mailboxes).
        stateDir: .agent-teams
        # Provider used to spawn member subagents ('spawn' or 'fork').
        memberProvider: spawn

readme.text:
**1.0.2 · 持久团队协作与 Fish 厂商美术**

[English](README.en.md)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish@1.0.2
```

也由 `@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish@1.0.2` 提供，不要重复挂载。安装后重启 DSH。Node 要求 `^22.19.0 || >=24`。推荐宿主 `0.2.0-rc.2`；`0.2.1-rc.2` 为预览支持。精确支持列表以 [compatibility.json](compatibility.json) 为唯一事实源，不以桌面应用版本推断核心版本。

- 先规划后审批：成员编排、任务依赖 DAG、信箱通信与进度监测。
- 持久成员、失败处理、重派能力凭据、停机与恢复，遵守宿主路由和模型白名单。
- 可选质量门：需求、实现、验证、审查、修复及集成，审查与产物绑定。
- Fish 美术：十八厂商识别，厂商与岗位头像、自定义 artworkDir、商标徽标及队长模型路由头像。缺图按“厂商+岗位 → 厂商 → 岗位”降级，不代表每个厂商都有全部岗位图。
- 新宿主预设型成员组合在子上下文安装人设和工具限制；缺失或损坏的限制在派发前拒绝。

旧 npm 名 `dsh-agent-teams-fish` 改为当前 scoped 名。更新直接依赖、bundle 名和覆盖行的 `name`，保留 `id: agent-teams`；不要同时加载两个来源。状态目录默认是工作区 `.agent-teams`，memberProvider 默认 `spawn`，自定义 artworkDir 使用本机路径。配置字段与团队数据格式不因本次包名整理改变。

先安全备份再迁移。成员使用真实模型额度；工具策略由部署方声明，不能以改名绕过。不会自动修复损坏日志、删除历史事件或重发中断任务。旧会话损坏应独立诊断。

以下命令按需手动执行。GitHub 验证仅保留手动触发，不再由 push、PR 或发布触发；标签发布直接使用已提交的构建产物，不依赖测试矩阵。已存在的 npm 版本跳过重复发布。本地 `prepublishOnly` 自动构建和验证钩子已移除，发布前是否构建与检查由维护者决定。插件运行时的权限确认与可选质量任务规则不变。

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm verify

诊断器 `dsh-agent-teams-doctor` 只检查清单和依赖闭包，不证明运行行为或识别当前进程。真实宿主验收与 UI 检查需要另行执行。

基于 [NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams) (原作者 Relakkes / 程序员阿江). MIT. 保留上游 README、NOTICE 和历史发布说明。1.0.2 统一包名与版本，不表示已合并上游最新 HEAD。

**1.0.2 · Durable teams with Fish vendor artwork**

[简体中文](README.md)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish@1.0.2
```

Also included in `@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish@1.0.2`; do not mount twice. Restart DSH after installation. Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`. Recommended Host: `0.2.0-rc.2`; `0.2.1-rc.2` is preview-supported. [compatibility.json](compatibility.json) is the exact support authority; desktop and core versions are distinct.

- Plan and approve before execution: member orchestration, task DAGs, durable mailboxes and progress monitoring.
- Persistent members, failure handling, capability-based reassignment, stop/resume and Host-enforced route/model policies.
- Optional quality gates for requirements, implementation, verification, review, repair and integration, binding judgments to artifacts.
- Fish artwork: eighteen vendor identities, role and vendor portraits, custom artworkDir, brand marks and route-aware captain portraits. Missing art falls back vendor+role → vendor → role; not every vendor has every role.
- Preset-only Hosts receive member persona and tool restrictions inside the child context; missing or corrupt restrictions refuse dispatch.

The old unscoped npm name `dsh-agent-teams-fish` moves to this scope. Update direct dependencies, bundle names and profile override `name` values, keeping `id: agent-teams`; never load both sources. State defaults to workspace `.agent-teams`, memberProvider to `spawn`; artworkDir is machine-local. The rename does not change configuration fields or team data format.

Back up securely first. Members consume real model quota. Tool policies are deployment-owned and cannot be bypassed by renaming. The plugin does not auto-repair logs, delete historical events or replay interrupted work; diagnose old corruption separately.

Run these commands manually as needed. GitHub verification is manual-only, never triggered by pushes, PRs or releases. Tag publishing uses committed build artifacts without the test matrix, and skips npm versions already published. The local `prepublishOnly` build/verification hook is removed; maintainers decide when to build and check. Runtime approvals and optional quality-task rules are unchanged.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm verify
The `dsh-agent-teams-doctor` command inspects manifests and dependency closure only; it does not prove runtime behavior or identify the current process. Real Host and UI acceptance are separate.

Based on [NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams) (original author Relakkes / 程序员阿江). MIT. Upstream READMEs, NOTICE and release history are preserved. 1.0.2 coordinates identity and version; it does not claim the latest upstream HEAD is merged.
